name: Eye Scream / Sweet Minnie's Soft-Serve Ice Cream
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Eye Scream Treats / Disney Treasure · Sweet Minnie's Ice Cream
whyItWorks: Complimentary pool-deck soft-serve has 0g fiber, lower milkfat than hard-scoop ice cream, and wafer cones dissolve into starch immediately.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Swirl vanilla, chocolate, or banana/mango soft-serve into a cup or wafer cone (take a Lactaid pill if sensitive to dairy, or ask a cast member for the dairy-free soy/oat frozen dessert kept behind the counter).
watchOuts: Lactose in standard soft-serve mix (dairy-free available on request)
